caption: Right after signup Toggl unlocked the whole product for a 31 day trial and said No credit card needed, while the pricing page speaks of a 30 day trial. The organization name is hidden.
We logged three entries of 1m 30s, 2m 18s and 15m. The day header adds them up to 18m, but the Logged bar above says 19m. The organization name is hidden.

After we set a $60 hourly rate on the project, the report turned our 15 minute entry into 15.00 USD billable. Every export format (PDF, CSV, XLSX) carries a star for paid plans. The organization name is hidden.

The upgrade window on yearly billing: Starter at $9 instead of $12 and Premium at $16 instead of $24 per license a month. It says the trial ends November 28 and you can keep going free with no charge. The organization name is hidden.
When we picked Premium, Toggl warned that the trial would finish immediately after confirming. We stopped here and paid nothing. The organization name is hidden.
The invite window says the free plan includes up to 5 members after the trial, while the pricing FAQ says 3 users. The account name is hidden.
Ending the trial is easy to find: Billing lists our Focus Premium trial, and its row menu offers Change plan and Cancel trial.
We tried to import our own Time logs export back in. Toggl read the empty fields as client, project and task names and skipped our time entries in match only mode. Our email address is hidden.
